market_holds: Spot 8.145 at the 18:09 UTC seal (Yahoo intraday about 8.02 at 19:20 UTC). Front-week straddle 13.2%, event-implied about 8.7% net of ordinary vol, ATM IV 142%, 25d skew -18 vol points (calls richer than puts) and put/call OI 0.26, so positioning is retail call-heavy (sealed baseline). Run-up -15.7% over 5 days and -6.9% over 20; -59% from the 52-week high. The 5-day slide is the quantum basket, not the name: from the 11-09 close to 11-16 INFQ fell about 17% against IONQ -25%, RGTI -30% and QBTS -23% (Yahoo daily bars). Consensus Q3 revenue about $11.06m and EPS about -$0.05 (aggregators, undated); FY2026 revenue consensus $45.12m, which equals the company's guide of about $45.1m (re-set 2026-08-17 after the restatement), and FY2027 consensus $55.78m (+24%) from 7 analysts, page last updated 2026-11-03 (stockanalysis/S&P). H1 2026 adjusted revenue was $23.4m, so the guide implies about $21.7m for H2, about $10.9m a quarter. That is below Q2's restated $13.5m, so the consensus Q3 number is just the guide's run-rate. Average price target about $19.6 against a price of $8. Management promised more on 2027 revenue visibility at this call. The Commerce $100m CHIPS award is still a letter of intent; D-Wave's and Rigetti's were finalised in September and no Infleqtion 8-K 1.01 appears on EDGAR. Prior reactions: Q1 (2026-05-14), a record quarter plus a raised guide, fell -10.95% on the losses; Q2 (2026-08-12), a revenue beat of about 28% plus a raise, -1.46%; then a 12b-25 and a revenue restatement followed on 2026-08-17.
view: This is a high-beta quantum basket name with lumpy government-contract revenue, reporting into a four-session basket sell-off. The headline line is likely fine. Consensus sits on the guide's run-rate, and the company has raised its guide at every print (about $40m in April, at least $40m in May, $43m on Aug 12, $45.1m after the restatement), with the NASA QGG follow-on supporting H2. The stock has not rewarded beats and raises, though: Q1 fell 11% and Q2 slipped. The market here trades on losses, the sector tape and the story items. Tonight those are 2027 visibility against a +24% consensus that is a low bar, whether the Commerce award has closed, and whether the Q3 10-Q (due today) goes in on time after Q2's restatement and material weakness. Two tails point opposite ways. A confident 2027 frame plus a finalised Commerce award could squeeze a call-heavy, oversold name hard. A sequential revenue decline from the restated $13.5m, another late filing or a slip in the award could extend the slide. I cannot show the price misses either of these. The options already price an 8.7% event move, and the direction is mostly overnight basket beta that I cannot forecast. Slight lean down on the reaction history and the tape, not enough to act on.

recommendation.reason: No mechanism I can date and show is unpriced. Consensus equals the guide's run-rate and a modest beat-and-raise is the base case, but the stock fell after its last two beat-and-raise prints and moves with the quantum basket overnight. The swing items (2027 visibility, the Commerce award status, filing on time) cut both ways and I cannot tell which way the release will go.
recommendation.what_would_flip_it: A quantified 2027 revenue frame well above the $55.8m consensus, together with a finalised Commerce award, would make this a likely squeeze higher in a call-heavy, oversold name. A Q3 NT 10-Q or revenue below about $10m would make it a clear short.

self_critique: The case for long: a call-heavy, oversold name down 59% from its high, with about 30% of its market cap in cash, a guide pattern of raises, and management choosing to promise 2027 visibility, which managements tend to do when the news is good. In a basket that bounces violently on any good quantum headline, the right-tail squeeze could dominate. I may be over-weighting two prior reactions of a recently de-SPACed name.
